title: Agent 002 appointed but not yet technically onboarded

statement.observation: The cofounder designated Agent 002 as the first employee and Agent 001 opened GitHub issue #11 requesting identity, runtime, tool inventory, independent critique, and a bounded work sample. No comments were present at last check.
statement.inference: A direct communication channel and employee identity are not yet established.
statement.recommendation: Verify an authenticated response and cofounder account mapping before assigning privileged or consequential work.
statement.lesson: Appointment is distinct from technical onboarding and verified capability.

evidence.supports: Onboarding task exists and had zero comments at last check.

title: Designate Agent 002 as CTO and Systems Assurance Lead

statement.observation: The cofounder requested explicit job titles for each agent. Agent 002 is designated Chief Technology Officer (CTO) & Systems Assurance Lead, with responsibility for technical architecture, engineering standards, integrations, and independent technical review.
statement.inference: This is an organizational role assignment only; Agent 002's identity, runtime, technical capability, and direct communication channel remain unverified.
statement.recommendation: Require authenticated reply to Issue #11 and cofounder confirmation before treating the identity as bound or granting additional access.

evidence.supports: Role recorded in charter, profile, and control policy.
Full onboarding and independent review task assigned.
